evals.prompt: Script this: https://www.instagram.com/reel/EXAMPLE/ I want my own take on this format.
evals.expected_output: Should decide short-form, spawn a subagent that transcribes the source with transcribe-url.sh and returns a format skeleton, load voice-dna.md and knowledge/ pages, pull 2-3 matching few-shot entries with find_voice.py, propose one twist grounded in backbone/messaging.md's proof bank, draft a beat sheet of complete-sentence beats with one CTA from backbone/offer.md, run a fresh-context voice-lint subagent, then create the Notion page with Status Scripting, Format Short-form, the Source URL, and Type left blank. If voice-corpus/ is missing it should stop and point to voice-corpus-builder.
assertions: Transcribes the source inside a subagent via transcribe-url.sh
Pulls few-shot examples with find_voice.py before drafting
Proposes a twist built only on real proof from backbone/messaging.md
Creates the Notion page with Status Scripting and leaves Type blank
